thread:
pagerduty-bot: [PAGER] high-priority: gpu-node-pool capacity exhausted (queue growth) - paging emma.sre and oncall

emma.sre: acked. seeing autoscaler errors in control plane, nodes not being created. queue backlog on inference service up 4x.

raj.infra: on it. initial glance: ASG attach failing with 403 from EC2: 'InstanceProfileCredentials not found' after launchconfig rotate at 02:13 UTC. Might be a creds/instance profile mismatch.

maya.ops: customer impact? any apps timed out?

emma.sre: yes, hosted inference p99 latency spiked and many requests queued. Circuit breaker kicked for a few customers; we have active support tickets from 2 enterprise customers.

aaron.eng: logs: autoscaler shows: 
```
I0328 02:18:41 autoscaler.go:423] scaleUp: nodegroup gpu-pool-1 - desired 12 current 4
E0328 02:18:42 provider_aws.go:312] attachInstanceProfile: error: AccessDenied: InstanceProfileCredentials not found
```

raj.infra: confirming: we rolled a new launch config for hotpatch earlier and rotated the instance profile name (to use new KMS role). ASG still references old profile; new instances fail to attach IAM role so kubelet can't register.

emma.sre: that explains taint + unready nodes. Are nodes launching but stuck in pending/terminated?

raj.infra: currently stuck in EC2 pending -> instance termination loop. console: 'Failed to attach IAM InstanceProfile' then terminate. No healthy nodes.

maya.ops: mitigation path?

ops-bot: checklist: 1) pause autoscaler 2) manually scale ASG to target 3) revert launchconfig 4) notify customers 5) handoff if >30m

aaron.eng: I can revert to previous launch config quickly. Will that preserve instance profile on new launches?

raj.infra: yes, previous LC has correct InstanceProfile arn: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:instance-profile/redwood-gpu-attach. If we roll back, new instances will boot with correct role and register.

emma.sre: do it. also set autoscaler to ignore this nodegroup until nodes are healthy? We want to avoid flapping triggers.

raj.infra: rolling LC revert now. running: 
```
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-1 --launch-configuration-name lc-20260303-v3
```

raj.infra: done. initiating manual scale to desired=10 to catch up queue.

ops-bot: manual scale command executed: desired capacity 10 -> triggering instance launches.

aaron.eng: watching cluster: kubelet joins starting to appear. kubelet logs show registration + node-labels ok.

emma.sre: good. can we drain any partially-registered nodes?

raj.infra: nodes are joining now with taint: nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule set by kubelet as expected. autoscaler: re-enabled.

maya.ops: queue length still high, estimate drain time ~9m per job; but with new nodes should clear in ~18-24m.

customer-bridge: Customer comms prepared: short note to impacted customers, ETA 30m, we're scaling additional capacity and rolling back a config change.

emma.sre: followups: 1) why LC rotation changed instance profile without ASG update? 2) prevent future rotations during peak windows 3) add autoscaler guard to detect persistent IAM failures and pause scale attempts+alert with runbook link.

raj.infra: root cause: CI/CD pipeline for launchconfigs applied a new LC template where instanceProfile variable pointed to the rotated name. The ASG was not updated by pipeline due to a conditional flag that we flipped manually. Bad gating.

aaron.eng: quick fix task created to add a preflight check in the LC pipeline: validate InstanceProfile exists and ASG has permission to assume before flipping. I'll PR a change with tests.

maya.ops: ops action: add schedule blackout for LC rolls between 00:00-06:00 UTC for gpu pools.

ops-bot: creating incident ticket: INC-20260328-014. severity: SEV2.

emma.sre: handoff plan: I'm going offline in 20m. If queue not cleared and p99 still >1s, escalate to pager oncall+infra lead.

raj.infra: monitoring: node join rate steady. current cluster gpu nodes = 10. queue length trending down from 4k -> 800.

aaron.eng: propose automation: autoscaler should detect repeated 'attachInstanceProfile' errors and set a 'scale inhibited' annotation on the nodegroup with reason + link to runbook. Will follow up on PR.

customer-bridge: sent note to customers at 02:40 UTC: "We're mitigating an autoscaling issue causing increased latency for GPU-backed inference. We've rolled back a configuration change and are scaling capacity. ETA 30-45 minutes. We'll follow up when queues are cleared."

maya.ops: can we confirm no data-exfil or security impact from the rotation?

raj.infra: no, only instance profile name changed; all KMS keys and roles locked down. Audit logs show only our CI user applied the LC. I've opened a post-change review.

emma.sre: status @02:55 UTC: p95 back to normal, queue ~120 and falling. We're moving to monitoring mode. I'll handoff to raj for postmortem and infra fixes.

raj.infra: taking handoff. follow-ups: write postmortem, enforce LC preflight, add autoscaler IAM-failure detector, schedule blackout windows, update runbook with launchconfig rollback steps and manual scale commands.

aaron.eng: added TODOs in infra sprint board.

maya.ops: closing pager but will keep watch. ping me if any new symptoms. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: incident resolved: actions in ticket INC-20260328-014.

emma.sre: thanks everyone. filing quick retrospective notes.

raj.infra: postmortem owner set: raj.infra, ETA: 48h.

customer-bridge: follow-up email scheduled to customers with root cause and compensatory measures.
